lines.en: The secretary told me that Mr. Harmsworth would see me.
lines.zh: 秘书告诉我说，哈姆斯沃斯先生要见我。

lines.en: I felt very nervous when I went into his office.
lines.zh: 我走进他办公室的时候感到非常紧张。

lines.en: He did not look up from his desk when I entered.
lines.zh: 我进去的时候，他没有从办公桌上抬起头来。

lines.en: After I had sat down, he said that business was very bad.
lines.zh: 我坐下之后，他说生意很不景气。

lines.en: He told me that the firm could not afford to pay such large salaries.
lines.zh: 他告诉我说，公司付不起这么大笔的薪水。
已经有二十个人离开了。

lines.en: I knew that my turn had come.
'Mr. Harmsworth,' I said in a weak voice.
lines.zh: “哈姆斯沃斯先生，”我用微弱的声音说。

lines.en: Then he smiled and told me I would receive an extra thousand pounds a year!
lines.zh: 接着他笑了笑，告诉我说我每年将额外得到一千英镑！

lead.question: 被老板叫去谈话，你会紧张吗？本课的好消息究竟是什么？
lead.warmup: 想象一下：秘书告诉你老板要见你，你忐忑地走进办公室，老板却头也不抬。他先说生意不景气、公司付不起高薪，还提到已有二十人离职——你多半以为自己要被辞退了。可最后一句话却峰回路转。听读前先猜一猜：等着这位职员的，究竟是坏消息还是好消息？
goals: 听懂并复述全文，抓住结尾的反转与幽默
掌握 secretary、nervous、afford、interrupt、look up 等核心词
巩固间接引语中时态、人称的呼应规则
会用 can't afford to、too ... to 表达压力与情绪
lead.summary: 本课讲一位职员被老板叫去谈话：他紧张得不敢开口，又听说生意不景气、二十人已离职，便认定自己要被辞退；结果老板宣布每年给他加薪一千英镑，反转成幽默。重点表达有 afford to pay such large salaries、in a weak voice、look up from his desk、an extra thousand pounds a year。
lead.tips: 读间接引语时，先把 he said that / he told me that 后的从句圈出来，再按“主句过去、从句退一步”还原原话，速度与准确率都会提高。

questions.a: The writer would receive an extra thousand pounds a year.
questions.aZh: 作者每年将额外得到一千英镑（加薪）。
questions.hint: 抓住最后一句的 smiled 与 extra thousand pounds。

questions.q: How did the writer feel when he went into the boss's office?
questions.zh: 作者走进老板办公室时感觉如何？
questions.hint: 注意第二句中的 nervous，以及他说话时 in a weak voice。

questions.q: Why had twenty people already left?
questions.zh: 为什么已经有二十个人离开了？
questions.a: Because business was very bad and the firm could not afford to pay such large salaries.
questions.aZh: 因为生意很不景气，公司付不起这么大笔的薪水。
questions.hint: 老板在作者坐下后给出的两个理由。

questions.q: What did the writer think when he said 'I knew that my turn had come'?
questions.zh: 作者说“我知道轮到我了”时，他以为会发生什么？
questions.a: He thought he was going to lose his job.
questions.aZh: 他以为自己要被解雇了。
questions.hint: 联系前文：二十人已离职，公司付不起高薪。

questions.q: Why is the story funny? What makes the ending surprising?
questions.zh: 这个故事为什么好笑？结尾为何出人意料？
questions.a: Because everything prepares us for bad news — nervousness, weak voice, twenty people leaving — but the boss ends with a pay rise, so the surprise creates humour.
questions.aZh: 因为全文都在铺垫坏消息——紧张、声音微弱、二十人离职——老板却以加薪收尾，反差制造了幽默。
questions.hint: 从“预期被解雇”与“结果加薪”的反差入手。

exercises.q: 汉译英：秘书告诉我说，哈姆斯沃斯先生要见我。
exercises.a: The secretary told me that Mr. Harmsworth would see me.
exercises.note: 间接引语时态后退一格。

exercises.q: 填空：After I had sat down, he said that business ____ very bad.
exercises.note: 主句过去时，从句用 was。

exercises.q: 汉译英：公司付不起这么大笔的薪水。
exercises.a: The firm could not afford to pay such large salaries.
exercises.note: afford 后接 to do 形式。

exercises.q: 句型转换（改为间接引语）：'Don't interrupt,' he said. → He told me ____ ____ interrupt.
exercises.note: 祈使句转 tell sb. not to do。

exercises.q: 改错：He did not looked up from his desk when I entered.
exercises.a: He did not look up from his desk when I entered.
exercises.note: 助动词 did 后用动词原形。

exercises.q: 填空：我紧张得一句话也说不出来。→ I was ____ nervous ____ say a word.
汉译英：“哈姆斯沃斯先生，”我用微弱的声音说。接着他笑了笑，告诉我说我每年将额外得到一千英镑。
exercises.a: 'Mr. Harmsworth,' I said in a weak voice. Then he smiled and told me I would receive an extra thousand pounds a year.
exercises.note: in a ... voice 表“用……的声音”。

quiz.q: The secretary told me that Mr. Harmsworth would see me. 句中 secretary 的意思是？
He did not look up from his desk. 句中 look up 的含义是？
quiz.note: 此处 look up 指“抬头看”，不是查阅。

quiz.q: The firm could not afford to pay such large salaries. 句中 afford 意为？
quiz.note: afford 常与 can/could 连用，后接 to do。

quiz.q: I said in a weak voice. 中 a weak voice 指什么样的声音？
quiz.note: weak 表虚弱无力，衬托作者的紧张。

quiz.q: He told me that the firm ____ afford to pay such large salaries. 应选？
quiz.note: 主句为过去时，从句情态动词也用过去式。

quiz.q: 故事中的“好消息”到底是什么？
options: 作者每年加薪一千英镑
quiz.note: 结尾反转：不是被辞退，而是加薪一千英镑。
